summary: Aliens of Sral is an interactive educational game that introduces children to Mars and astronaut life. Players take on the role of astronauts at a Mars base, complete missions, overcome unexpected challenges, and make decisions to survive. Our goal is to make space science fun and accessible while developing children's curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
details: Aliens of Sral is a browser-based educational game that allows children to experience astronaut life on Mars through missions, quizzes, and unexpected challenges. Using NASA images and scientific data, the game introduces Mars's gravity, atmosphere, and rocky surface in an engaging way. Our aim is to develop children's scientific curiosity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. The project features custom-designed visuals, a simple, child-friendly interface, and interactive gameplay, combining scientific learning with exploration. During development, our team prioritized scientific accuracy, accessibility, creativity, and ease of use. But the most especially, our team prioritized to make the player have fun while playing.
